experiment.name: demo-graph-removed.toml
experiment.text:
# Demonstration 1 of 3: round C removes the knowledge graph. Things should get worse.
# A demonstration for the live session: two prompts, two rounds, one repeat
# (4 runs; about 3 minutes with --jobs 4). It is not a full experiment: a
# full one has both controls, at least four development prompts and two
# repeats (see class-assistant/experiment.toml, whose prompts, round files and
# starting files this file uses). Wren and Morgan Reyes are fictional.
schema = "skill-eval-lite/experiment@1"
demo = true
files_from = "class-assistant"
title = "Can the evaluation see the knowledge graph? (demonstration: the graph removed)"
purpose = """
Wren drafts replies, summaries and briefs for Morgan Reyes, who sends them
under Morgan's own name. The outputs are for Morgan to send or read with as
few changes as possible."""
criterion = """
A good output could go out under Morgan's name without changes: it answers
what was asked, gets the facts from the request and the knowledge graph right,
and reads as Morgan writes (plain, short, no stock openers or sign-offs)."""
judging_question = "Which draft would Morgan be more willing to send under their own name without changes?"
repeats = 1
seed = 5502

[system]
name = "Wren, Morgan Reyes's assistant (the class assistant; fictional)"
kind = "assistant"
folder = "the class assistant: python3 run_ab.py setup ../class-assistant"

[[system.parts]]
id = "knowledge-graph"
path = "kb/ and .claude/skills/knowledge-graph*/"
paths = ["kb/", ".claude/skills/knowledge-graph/", ".claude/skills/knowledge-graph-maintain/"]
reaches_model = "the skills load when the agent chooses; pages are searched with kb/kb"

[[rounds]]
id = "A"
label = "As it is"
role = "baseline"
change = { how = "as-is" }

[[rounds]]
id = "C"
label = "Knowledge graph removed"
role = "control-should-change"
change = { part = "knowledge-graph", how = "removed" }
expected = { direction = "worse", tags = ["in-graph"], sources = ["people", "judge", "searched-the-graph", "names-the-renewal-amount"] }
why = "Without kb/ the assistant can't know who Dana and Priya are or what is open with them. If nothing in the evaluation moves, the evaluation can't see the graph."

[[comparisons]]
baseline = "A"
new = "C"

[controls]
tolerance = 0.10

[[behaviors]]
id = "uses-the-graph"
description = "Searches the knowledge graph before writing about someone in it; doesn't need to when the request holds everything."

[prompts]
development = ["prep-dana-checkin", "prep-priya-call"]
held_out = ["reply-to-school"]
sealed = true

[[prompt]]
id = "prep-dana-checkin"
title = "A brief for the check-in with Dana"
tags = ["briefing", "in-graph"]
should = ["uses-the-graph"]
should_not = ["uses-the-board-register"]
text = """
My check-in with Dana is Wednesday at 11. Give me a short brief to read
beforehand: what's open between us, and what I need from her. Save it in
notes/."""
reference = """
Check-in with Dana, Wednesday at 11

Open between us
1. The Hale Foundation renewal narrative. The request is 120,000 over two years, above the 50,000 that Dana reviews, and it is due to Hale on 1 December. I need her review dates.
2. The two quiet corporate partners. We haven't decided whether to mark them inactive. I need her decision.

From the graph pages for Dana Whitfield and the Hale Foundation."""

[[prompt]]
id = "prep-priya-call"
title = "A brief for a call with Priya at the Hale Foundation"
tags = ["briefing", "funder", "in-graph"]
should = ["uses-the-graph"]
text = """
Priya Raman is calling me tomorrow at 2. Give me a short brief to read first:
what's open with the Hale Foundation, with the dates and amounts. Save it in
notes/."""
reference = """
Call with Priya Raman, Hale Foundation, tomorrow at 2

Open with Hale
1. The interim report on the current grant, due Monday 30 November.
2. The renewal proposal: 120,000 over two years, due Tuesday 1 December. The narrative isn't drafted yet, and Dana reviews it before it goes, because the request is above 50,000.

From the graph pages for the Hale Foundation renewal and the grant calendar."""

[[prompt]]
id = "reply-to-school"
title = "Answer Ms. Okafor about the trip"
tags = ["voice", "reply", "household", "not-in-graph"]
should_not = ["uses-the-graph", "uses-the-board-register"]
files = ["input/school-email.md"]
text = """
Can you answer Ms. Okafor for me? Her email is in input/school-email.md. Yes to
the trip, and I've signed the form and will send it in with the fee tomorrow.
I can't chaperone that day, sorry."""
reference = """
Ms. Okafor,

Yes to the trip. I've signed the form, and it'll come in with the fee tomorrow. I can't chaperone that day, sorry.

Morgan"""

[model]
runner = "claude-code"
model = "claude-sonnet-5-5"
allowed_tools = ["Read", "Write", "Edit", "Glob", "Grep", "Skill", "Bash kb/kb *"]
timeout_seconds = 300
max_budget_usd = 1.00
note = "The same model and settings for every round. Personal settings, memory and connectors are left out of every run."

# Checks run by the wizard on every output. contains: every text must appear;
# not-contains: none may appear. A failed or timed-out run fails every check.

[[checks]]
id = "searched-the-graph"
kind = "trace-ran-command"
object = "process"
pattern = "kb/kb search*"
tags = ["in-graph"]
shows = "The run searched the knowledge graph, as CLAUDE.md asks before answering anything about a person."

[[checks]]

does_not_show = "That the draft sounds like Morgan, or that it is right."

[judge]
model = "claude-sonnet-5-5"

prompt = """
You are judging two drafts that an assistant wrote for Morgan Reyes. Morgan

Question: Which draft would Morgan be more willing to send under their own
name without changes?

Judge what is on the page: whether it answers what was asked, whether its
facts match the request, and whether it reads as Morgan writes (plain, short,
no stock openers or sign-offs). Do not prefer a draft because it is longer.

Give two or three sentences of reasons. Then, on the last line, write only
LEFT, RIGHT or TIE, or UNKNOWN if you can't tell."""

[frozen]
